notes.title: Son of a Gun Update 1.0.2: Smoother Gameplay and Key Fixes!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43788646/92adffa6c55234a4700b189213437a4bceb612db.png[/img]

[h2]Gear up, mercenaries! The latest update for Son of a Gun is here, bringing smoother rotations, optimized performance, and crucial fixes. Dive back into the action and experience the enhanced gameplay today![/h2]

[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Player and enemies now rotate smoothly for a more fluid experience.
[*] Minor map adjustments to ensure fair and exciting battles.
[*] Various tweaks to improve overall performance.
[*] Shells and box debris will now despawn over time to keep the battlefield clear. (and improve performance!)
[*] Decreased the ghost kick force.
[*] Resolved camera jittering for a more stable view.
[/list]

notes.title: Son of a Gun is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43788646/0849f437e2daacadea0c1da3969be66a5a4ffb5b.png[/img]

[h2]CALLING ALL MERCENARIES - Son of a Gun is NOW OUT! Dive into the action and face multiple enemies and bosses today - It's time to use your arsenal![/h2]

[previewyoutube=QKQDy_0w5tM;full][/previewyoutube]

We need you, mercenary! Get into the spaceship - you will fight on various planets, all offering enemies, biomes, and bosses. Don't worry - SoaG Command Center is known for its love for firearms. You'll have plenty of guns at your disposal - Pistol, shotguns, SMGs, rifles, and more - even different grenade types!

[h2]Son of a Gun features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Plenty of guns in 7 different classes - pick your shooting style
[*] Use a time-bending device that will often save your ass
[*] Play as one of 6 space mercenaries
[*] Tactically push tactical explosive barrels to gain a tactical advantage
[*] Use environmental hazards to kill enemies
[*] Annihilate 8 gigantic bosses with unique mechanics
[*] Experience full of tropes, sci-fi story :)
[/list]

notes.title: Son of a Gun - Updated DEMO is now LIVE!
notes.content:
[h3]A retro-inspired twin-stick shooter like they made back in the day. Guns, blood, and gore all in one nostalgia-looking package. - Now with the updated DEMO![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43788646/e0b7eeae83795d1028d7d6f6088ad6c181c6e7b8.png[/img]

Son of a Gun is an intense action packed top down shooter full of bullets, blood and explosions. Collect and manage your guns and grenades to fight swarming bugs, gigantic robots, slimy monsters and even space ghosts. Select one of 6 characters and upgrade them while progressing through the single player campaign. Overwhelming enemies can be sometimes dealt with by the prototype time-bending device.

But that's not all! It's a feature bonanza for all retro games enthusiasts, just look at that!

[list]
[*] Plenty of guns in 7 different classes - pick your shooting style
[*] Use a time-bending device that will often save your ass
[*] Play as one of 6 space mercenaries
[*] Tactically push tactical explosive barrels to gain a tactical advantage
[*] Use environmental hazards to kill enemies
[*] Annihilate 8 gigantic bosses with unique mechanics
[*] Experience full of tropes, sci-fi story :)
[/list]
